name: Shinozuka Misuzu
source:
This "Ice Queen" has quite the attitude. She's haughty and demanding, acting put upon even having to interact with [url=https://vndb.org/c60294]Kazuma[/url]. In reality, this behavior is a mechanism to hide parts of herself that she finds embarassing. Once she's put in a compromising position, though, they're bared for all to see.

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582992-do-you-like-horny-bunnies-2/faqs/34122]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
